carry_forward.brief: dial: home-iot control + media app (web+mobile, everyday people at home); lineage Braun/Ulm (Rams), light warm-white ABS base + charcoal dark; one orange accent per unit; plain backdrops; targets React/Tailwind/Figma/SwiftUI; budget standard; full answers in system/INTAKE.md
carry_forward.lineage_name: Braun / Ulm school industrial design (Dieter Rams, Weniger aber besser) — user-declared; nearest catalogued structure 07-instrument-panel
carry_forward.signature_move: One loud thing per unit: the single orange part is the primary control you turn or press, everything else is warm-white matte plastic and grey ink
carry_forward.fit_statement: A home control app has the appliance problem Rams solved: an everyday person must read state and find the one control that matters at a glance, with nothing decorative competing
carry_forward.loud_axis: surface at 8: one matte ABS material lit from top-left, perforated grilles, LCD/OLED windows, detented mechanisms
carry_forward.loud_axis_payment: type at 1 (one grotesk) and grid at 2 (one module, fixed positions)
principles: P1 One loud thing per unit
P2 The display tells the state
P5 Type is a label, not a voice
P6 Lasts, so it stays still

reference_table.status: estimated from chat, re-measure from ref-01.png
reference_table.1_hierarchy: colour reserved for one thing (the orange primary control) + enclosure (each device is its own body; the display is a recessed window)
reference_table.2_colour_roles: ground (warm white plastic, slightly lighter page behind), structure ink (mid/dark grey printing, grille holes), one reserved accent (orange, primary control only; small side buttons sometimes orange too — secondary), display families: LCD grey-green with dark segments, OLED/CRT near-black with white or green text
reference_table.3_rhythm: body inset ≈ 1/12 of the short side; grille pitch ≈ hole diameter × 1.6; radius ≈ 15–18% of the short side; labels on the bottom inset line
reference_table.4_density: dense inside grilles and keypads, generous everywhere else; the display + one control occupies ~60% of the face
reference_table.5_signature: one orange control per unit against a calm white body
reference_table.6_type: set grotesk, single weight, lowercase model name bottom-right, wordmark bottom-left; 7-segment numerals on LCD; tabular
reference_table.7_material: matte ABS, soft top-left light, short soft shadow below, faint lit top edge; translated as material tokens (height/gloss/roughness/mass), never as texture
reference_table.8_edges: rounded rectangle bodies with a fine seam line; recessed windows with an inner shade; no hard rules between regions, gaps instead
reference_table.9_absent: no gradients, no patterns as ornament, no second accent hue, no bold display type, no icons where a printed word fits
reference_table.10_failure: the photographed light-grey-on-white labels fail 4.5:1 and would be unreadable on screen; a dense app list would break the one-device-per-unit rhythm — lists need a quieter row form
reference_table.divergence: reference labels are too faint: P5 overrides the reference and raises ink to ≥4.5:1; no pull on the vector

carry_forward.plan: Anchor round: device card (display + grille + loud knob + keys + ruler scale + model name + wordmark), 4 variants in apps/lab/anchor/ over display:grille ratio, knob size, shadow depth, label placement; user picks. Then Phase 2 tokens (matte ABS material, warm-white/charcoal themes, one orange, LCD/OLED families, allowSeed false). Wave 1 per kiln:production-run: layout primitives, atoms (Button/key, Switch/rocker, Slider/fader, Rotary, Select, Display LCD+OLED, Grille meter, Label, Icon, Focus), home-iot wave 1 extras, docs controls. Book at standard depth; verify full; milestone M1.
carry_forward.out_of_scope: npm publish / git push; native SwiftUI components (tokens only); Braun name or logo; photographic textures; waves 2-3 media (player, progress, list) beyond M1; brand identity beyond a plain dial wordmark
carry_forward.riskiest_slice: device card anchor: material + display + grille + knob must read as one honest appliance without becoming a retro costume or a bloated toy
carry_forward.stamp: dial · lineage Braun/Ulm (Rams) · vector C3 T1 G2 S8 M3 D4 · loud surface 8 paid by type 1 + grid 2 · anchor A (D-001)

acceptance_criteria: Every unit shows at most one orange part, and it is the primary control
Every text and label is >=4.5:1 on its material in light and dark
A person can read a device state from its display in one glance without reading any other text
Every rotary/fader/key works by keyboard (arrows step a detent, Home/End, Space/Enter) and declares mechanism+spring in why.json
No Braun name or mark anywhere in code, docs or assets
